items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution increase
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterquell Krankenkasse, Am Brunnenhof 2, 35390 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18.11.2026. 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post' (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): 4th day after posting = Sun 22.11.2026; for social-law letters this deemed-delivery day itself does not shift for falling on a weekend. Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (22.11.) is not counted, so the one-month period (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) runs from 23.11.2026 and ends on the day in the next month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. Tue 22.12.2026. That day is a normal working day (not a weekend/holiday in Hessen, the Kasse's seat), so no further shift applies under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X.

items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 betragen Ihre monatlichen Beiträge 318,46 €.

items.quote: Wir buchen den Beitrag weiter zum 15. des Folgemonats ab.
items.computation: The contribution for a given month is debited on the 15th of the following month. The first contribution at the new rate is for January 2027, so it is debited on 15 February 2027. 15.02.2027 is a Monday, so no weekend shift is needed.

warnings: The letter gives no breakdown of how the new rate was calculated beyond referencing the Kasse's new Zusatzbeitragssatz and the 2025 Steuerbescheid income; if the figure seems wrong, request the calculation before the Widerspruch deadline.

The collecting IBAN (DE60 5135 0025 0008 3006 00) is well-formed and matches a Hessen bank, consistent with the sender's address in Mustergießen (HE), but this only confirms the IBAN's format, not account ownership — compare it against earlier statements from this Kasse if in doubt.
